text: Theo’s childhood fascination with the stars was not merely a hobby, but a profound emotional anchor connecting him to his late mother, an astrophysicist who had nurtured his curiosity about the universe. From the rooftop of their rural home, he spent countless nights looking up, seeking comfort in the celestial patterns she had taught him to recognize. This deep-seated bond drove his actions and motives, leading him to pursue a path in science not just for knowledge, but to feel close to her memory. In his moments of reflection, he often recalled her gentle explanations of the sky, including how fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, a simple truth that grounded his complex grief in the natural world.
